88    /**
89     * Generates a french catch phrase.
90     *
91     * @return string
92     */
93    public function catchPhrase()
94    {
95        do {
96            $format = static::randomElement(static::$catchPhraseFormats);
97            $catchPhrase = ucfirst($this->generator->parse($format));
98
99            if ($this->isCatchPhraseValid($catchPhrase)) {
100                break;
101            }
102        } while (true);
103
104        return $catchPhrase;
105    }

107    /**
108     * Generates a siret number (14 digits) that passes the Luhn check.
109     *
110     * @see http://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Syst%C3%A8me_d'identification_du_r%C3%A9pertoire_des_%C3%A9tablissements
111     *
112     * @return string
113     */
114    public function siret($formatted = true)
115    {
116        $siret = self::siren(false);
117        $nicFormat = static::randomElement(static::$siretNicFormats);
118        $siret .= $this->numerify($nicFormat);
119        $siret .= Luhn::computeCheckDigit($siret);
120
121        if ($formatted) {
122            $siret = substr($siret, 0, 3) . ' ' . substr($siret, 3, 3) . ' ' . substr($siret, 6, 3) . ' ' . substr($siret, 9, 5);
123        }
124
125        return $siret;
126    }
127
128    /**
129     * Generates a siren number (9 digits) that passes the Luhn check.
130     *
131     * @see http://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Syst%C3%A8me_d%27identification_du_r%C3%A9pertoire_des_entreprises
132     *
133     * @return string
134     */
135    public static function siren($formatted = true)
136    {
137        $siren = self::numerify('%#######');
138        $siren .= Luhn::computeCheckDigit($siren);
139
140        if ($formatted) {
141            $siren = substr($siren, 0, 3) . ' ' . substr($siren, 3, 3) . ' ' . substr($siren, 6, 3);
142        }
143
144        return $siren;
145    }

147    /**
148     * @var array An array containing string which should not appear twice in a catch phrase.
149     */
150    protected static $wordsWhichShouldNotAppearTwice = ['sécurité', 'simpl'];
151
152    /**
153     * Validates a french catch phrase.
154     *
155     * @param string $catchPhrase The catch phrase to validate.
156     *
157     * @return bool (true if valid, false otherwise)
158     */
159    protected static function isCatchPhraseValid($catchPhrase)
160    {
161        foreach (static::$wordsWhichShouldNotAppearTwice as $word) {
162            // Fastest way to check if a piece of word does not appear twice.
163            $beginPos = strpos($catchPhrase, $word);
164            $endPos = strrpos($catchPhrase, $word);
165
166            if ($beginPos !== false && $beginPos != $endPos) {
167                return false;
168            }
169        }
170
171        return true;
172    }
